If you have a public repo like
https://github.com/YourUser/metablooms-deltas

And inside it a file like
feeds/core.json

Then the raw URL will look like:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/YourUser/metablooms-deltas/main/feeds/core.json

As long as:

The repo is public, and

The path is correct,

I can fetch that raw URL over HTTPS and parse whatever’s there (JSON, text, etc.) and then use it "
